name: Itadaki Djungarian
original_name: いただきじゃんがりあん
source: Debut work of Studio Miris. Satou Kazumi is a big fan of Eroge and Mahjong. One day, his sister Suzune tells him that the family restaurant "Djungarian", which their family runs, is close to a crisis. Kazumi decides to go to headhunting for show girls rival shops with his strong Mahjong...
translation: Studio Miris的处女作。佐藤和己是成人游戏和麻将的狂热爱好者。一天，妹妹铃音告诉他，家里经营的家庭餐厅“Djungarian”正面临危机。和己决定凭借高超麻将技术，从竞争店铺挖来表演女郎…
